import sys
from _pytest.capture import _get_multicapture, FDCapture, SysCapture, MultiCapture

def test_get_multicapture_fd():
    result = _get_multicapture("fd")
    assert isinstance(result, MultiCapture)
    assert isinstance(result.in_, FDCapture)
    assert isinstance(result.out, FDCapture)
    assert isinstance(result.err, FDCapture)
    assert result.in_.targetfd == 0
    assert result.out.targetfd == 1
    assert result.err.targetfd == 2

def test_get_multicapture_sys():
    result = _get_multicapture("sys")
    assert isinstance(result, MultiCapture)
    assert isinstance(result.in_, SysCapture)
    assert isinstance(result.out, SysCapture)
    assert isinstance(result.err, SysCapture)
    assert result.in_.name == "stdin"
    assert result.out.name == "stdout"
    assert result.err.name == "stderr"

def test_get_multicapture_no():
    result = _get_multicapture("no")
    assert isinstance(result, MultiCapture)
    assert result.in_ is None
    assert result.out is None
    assert result.err is None

def test_get_multicapture_tee_sys():
    result = _get_multicapture("tee-sys")
    assert isinstance(result, MultiCapture)
    assert result.in_ is None
    assert isinstance(result.out, SysCapture)
    assert isinstance(result.err, SysCapture)
    # just ensure they are SysCapture; tee logic not exposed
    assert result.out.name == "stdout"
    assert result.err.name == "stderr"

def test_get_multicapture_unknown():
    try:
        _get_multicapture("unknown")
        assert False, "expected ValueError"
    except ValueError as e:
        assert "unknown capturing method" in str(e)

    # Input less than "fd" should raise ValueError in original
